private static final long mod = 998244353;
public static void main(String[] args) 
{
   Scanner ray = new Scanner(System.in);
   int n = ray.nextInt();
   long kk = ray.nextLong();
   if(kk >= n)
   {
      System.out.println("0");
   }
   else
   {
   int k = (int)(kk);
   int r = n - k;
   long[] rChoose = new long[r+1];
   rChoose[0] = 1;
   long numChoose = 1;
   long denomChoose = 1;
   for(int i = 1; i <= r; i++)
   {
      numChoose = (numChoose*(r+1-i)) % mod;
      denomChoose = (denomChoose*i) % mod;
      rChoose[i] = (numChoose*power(denomChoose, mod-2)) % mod;
   }
   long ans = 0;
   long flipper = 1;
   for(int i = 0; i <= r; i++) //PIE
   {
      ans += power((long)(r-i), (long)(n))*flipper*rChoose[i];
      ans = ans % mod;
      flipper = -flipper;
   }
   ans = ans * choose((long)(n), (long)(k));
   ans = ans % mod;
   if(k > 0)
   {
      ans = ans*2;
   }
   ans = ans % mod;
   if(ans < 0)
   {
      ans += mod;
   }
   System.out.println(""+ans);
   }
public static long choose(long n, long k)  
{ 
   long num = 1;
   long denom = 1;
   for(int i = (int)(n-k+1); i <= n; i++)
   {
      num = (num*i) % mod;
   } 
   for(int i = 1; i <= k; i++)
   {
      denom = (denom*i) % mod;
   } 
   denom = power(denom, mod-2) % mod;
   return (num*denom) % mod;
} 
public static long power(long x, long y) 
{ 
    long res = 1;      
    x = x % mod;
    while (y > 0) 
    { 
        
        if (y % 2 == 1) 
        {    res = res*x; 
            res = res % mod;}
        
        y = y>>1;  
        x = x*x; 
        x = x % mod; 
    } 
    return res; 
}
}
